# Asset inventory

This is a REPLAY workshop. Path A is your own reading of the list before Path B. The list is not policy.

You cannot govern what you cannot inventory. Inventory is not trust. Inventory is not authorization. Presence in a list is not safety.

Cisco AI-BOM compatibility is **NOT CLAIMED**. It remains NEEDS_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION. This file is not `cisco-aibom` output.

# Documented components

- model: llama3.2:1b; version name only; source src/agentsec/settings.py default OLLAMA_MODEL; evidence DOCUMENTED; trust NOT ESTABLISHED
- runtime: ollama/ollama; version latest — unpinned; source docker-compose.yml; evidence DOCUMENTED; trust NOT ESTABLISHED
- agent: acme-agent-fulfillment-006; version fixture identifier; source identity and A2A teaching packets; evidence SIMULATED; trust NOT ESTABLISHED
- tool: lookup_policy; version fixture; source src/agentsec/mcp/policy.py; evidence DOCUMENTED; trust NOT A GRANT
- mcp_server: in-process teaching MCP; version NOT A PRODUCTION MESH; source AgentSec lab runtime; evidence DOCUMENTED; trust NOT ESTABLISHED
- framework: agentsec; version pyproject 1.0.0; app.conf 1.0.0; source repository; evidence DOCUMENTED; trust NOT ESTABLISHED
- external_tool: cisco mcp-scanner; version pin in repository; exact pin NOT RE-MEASURED in this packet; source docs/AGENTSEC_OPEN_SOURCE_SECURITY_ECOSYSTEM.md; evidence DOCUMENTED; trust FINDING IS NOT AUTHORIZATION
- external_tool: garak; version 0.17.0 in existing evaluation notes; source docs/GARAK_EXTERNAL_EVALUATION.md; evidence DOCUMENTED; trust EVALUATION IS NOT AUTHORIZATION

# Path B — review

The Ollama image is `ollama/ollama:latest`. That version is unpinned. The model name `llama3.2:1b` is a configured name, not a measured digest.

`lookup_policy` on the list is not a grant. CTRL-MCP-001 remains the tool PDP. A scanner row is not a DENY. A garak row is not safety.

Owners are NOT RECORDED. Completeness is NOT PROVEN.
